items.requirement: The command and cells terminals derive their type, spacing and colour from the agent terminal (owner, 2026-11-24), specialised only where they need it
evidence: Type: both roots carry data-terminal-type, so they take the agent terminal's recipe; their own font-mono text-[12.5px] and leading-[1.5] are gone, the load-failure text included

Rows: heights are counted in the type's rows ({rows}lh, h-[1lh]) and the slide and touch scroll read the row from terminal-screen's rowHeight (the computed line-height), so no host keeps a pitch of its own

Remeasure: terminal-screen's CellProbe sits in every host, and remeasure() sends one window resize a frame for all of them, so a code-scale change or a late face redraws a command or cells view with no agent terminal on the page

Colour: one palette (loadWasm's set_palette) as before; the ground is now the agent terminal's canvas, bg-term-canvas in CSS and Palette::canvas() in command.rs (frame, VT ground, edge fade) and cells.rs, where they had the panel ground
Specialised: a program's faint (SGR 2) output is muted in its colour, half way to its ground as half opacity drew it, since the type draws DIM at full opacity (command.rs faint, FAINT)
Kept as they were: the frame's 6px padding (py-1.5) and the crate's one-column margin each side

renders-side/measured.json, all four themes: every grid is exactly its rows (frame 70px = 4 x 17.5, 210px = 12 x 17.5), line-height 17.5px, weight 450, ligatures none, ground rgb(18, 18, 18) in Vitesse dark and light; HEAD: 18.75, 400, ligatures on, panel ground
Tests: a_command_sits_on_the_agent_terminals_canvas, faint_output_is_muted_in_its_colour_and_keeps_its_lighter_weight, the_cells_sit_on_the_agent_terminals_canvas; cargo test 274 passed
